idea: A 90-second cinematic video of a man building an underground house
title: Below
logline: One man, one shovel, one year beneath the earth.
hook: Everyone said it couldn't be done with bare hands.

beats.summary: Empty field at dawn; a man arrives with a shovel
First cuts into the earth; the hole begins
The pit deepens; seasons turn; exhaustion
Walls rise from timber and stone
The roof closes over; earth covers it
Warm light from a window set into the hillside
